text:
Maria (CS): quick pulse — ACME asked for a SOC2 scope map showing tenant isolation boundaries + a named list of evidence owners for renewal. Need to hand off by EOD Wed or renewal checklist stalls.
Ana (Security): I have the lockbox/egress diagram. can paste a link in a sec. do we need network ACLs broken down by environment? :thinking_face:
Sam (Solutions): I own the app-level config evidence (RBAC + tenant metadata flow). I can list owners: Sam, Priya, and infra owns the KV backups.
Kevin (Legal): Confirming: they want evidence that customer data is not co-mingled with other tenants and an export path for deletion requests. Also will ask for DPA clause pointers.
Maria (CS): perfect. can each owner drop a single artifact (diagram, short note, or pointer to tracking ticket) into the shared folder: /onboarding/renewals/ACME/2026-SOC2-evidence by Tue 5pm?
OnboardBot: Reminder created — folder /onboarding/renewals/ACME/2026-SOC2-evidence (due 2026-03-24T17:00Z). Assigned: Sam, Ana, Infra-Team.
Ana (Security): sharing diagram now — https://rwd.example.com/diagrams/lockbox-tenant-boundary.png  (contains: tenant namespaces, KV separation, pub/sub topics masked). Also note: backups are encrypted with customer-specific keys for Dedicated customers; add that as evidence text.
Sam (Solutions): adding my note: "App ownership: Sam (Solutions) — how tenant metadata is namespaced; ticket #OPS-4821 contains config diff; link: https://rwd.example.com/tickets/OPS-4821"
Maria (CS): Kevin — can you add a brief DPA-friendly blurb about subcontractors/subprocessors and where logs live? We need plain-language sentences they can paste into their form.
Kevin (Legal): I can do a 2–3 sentence blurb. will post in the folder by EOD Mon. also flag: if ACME requests on-prem BYOK, that'll change evidence set — heads up CS team.
Tom (ACME): thanks for the quick coordination team — appreciate the timeline. one ask: can you also confirm retention for embeddings derived from tenant data?
Ana (Security): short answer: embeddings retention follows customer-configured retention policy; default 90 days for Hosted. I'll add the exact config path and retention policy snippet.
Maria (CS): checklist so we're aligned:
````
- Diagram: tenant isolation (Ana)
- App ownership + ticket links (Sam)
- Backups & KMS proof (Infra)
- DPA/text for subprocessors (Kevin)
- Retention snippet for embeddings (Ana)
- Final README for ACME upload (Maria)
````
Maria (CS): tagging owners again: @Ana (Security) @Sam (Solutions) @Kevin (Legal) — please confirm you've dropped artifacts in /onboarding/renewals/ACME/2026-SOC2-evidence by Tue 17:00 UTC. If anyone needs me to draft the README for ACME, I can do that tomorrow morning. :raised_hands:
Sam (Solutions): confirmed — I'll upload OPS-4821 diff + a 1-paragraph note.
Ana (Security): confirmed — diagram + retention snippet uploaded.
Kevin (Legal): confirmed — DPA blurb uploaded and a short checklist for required signatures.
Maria (CS): awesome — I'll stitch into a README and ping ACME with the bundle Wed AM. thanks everyone! :tada:
